description: This file defines the internal implementation of the StateMachineManager class, which manages durable state machines, handles logging, recovery, and lifecycle events within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for registering state machines, initializing, recovering state, writing logs, and handling lifecycle participation.

classes.name: StateMachineManager
classes.description: Manages durable state machines, handles log appending, recovery, and lifecycle events within Orleans.

classes.name: StateMachineLogWriter
classes.description: Provides methods to append entries and snapshots to the log for a specific state machine.

classes.name: StateMachineManagerState
classes.description: A durable dictionary that tracks state machine IDs and manages their reset and ID assignment.

classes.name: WorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for the StateMachineManager's internal processing queue.

methods.name: RegisterStateMachine
methods.description: Registers a new durable state machine with a given name.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the StateMachineManager asynchronously, preparing it for operation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the internal work loop for processing queued work items.

methods.name: WorkLoop
methods.description: Main processing loop handling log appending, recovery, and state management tasks.

methods.name: AppendUpdatesOrSnapshotStateMachine
methods.description: Appends either updates or a snapshot of a state machine to the log segment.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Deletes the current state, resetting the storage and state machine IDs.

methods.name: RecoverAsync
methods.description: Recovers state from storage, applying log entries to state machines.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Queues a write operation to persist current state and logs.

methods.name: OnSetStateMachineId
methods.description: Sets the ID for a state machine, updating internal mappings.

methods.name: TryGetStateMachine
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a state machine by name.
